facts.text: I made dinner, I think, and it smells like chips. Pass me one and I promise to remember who cooked.
facts.why: The quote page lists Dory's real lines (Just keep swimming, I can read) and not this one. It plays on her memory loss, which is true to her, but it is printed in quote marks.
facts.fix: Use a note: I made dinner, I think. Ask me who cooked it in five minutes and I won't remember. Eat up anyway.
